review_signals_binary.name: review_signals_binary
review_signals_binary.value:
coalesce("reviews"."sig_on_time", 0) IN (0, 1) AND coalesce("reviews"."sig_quality", 0) IN (0, 1)
        AND coalesce("reviews"."sig_fair_price", 0) IN (0, 1) AND coalesce("reviews"."sig_respectful", 0) IN (0, 1)

worker_complete_has_fields.name: worker_complete_has_fields
worker_complete_has_fields.value:
"worker_profiles"."onboarding_status" <> 'complete' OR ("worker_profiles"."trade" IS NOT NULL AND "worker_profiles"."years_experience" IS NOT NULL
        AND "worker_profiles"."indicative_rate_pkr" IS NOT NULL AND "worker_profiles"."rate_basis" IS NOT NULL AND cardinality("worker_profiles"."area_slugs") > 0)
